BearSSL 0.6, taken from https://github.com/arduino-libraries/ArduinoBearSSL (src/bearssl).
The Arduino-specific parts are only active when ARDUINO is defined, which EmberOS does not do.

Local change for EmberOS:
- inner.h: the CPU-intrinsics include block is skipped when BR_NO_INTRINSICS is defined
  (EmberOS builds with no SSE/AES-NI/RDRAND code and no C library headers).
